name: redbelly-made-simple
description: Redbelly explained in everyday language: an 85-second narrated animated explainer, its captions, sources and verification suite.

scripts.mix: python3 audio/compose.py && node tools/render.mjs --ar 16x9 --audio-only && node tools/render.mjs --ar 9x16 --audio-only
scripts.produce: npm run captions && npm run audio && npm run render && npm run docs && npm run verify -- --write
